query:
SELECT id, state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_vote_pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_vote_pct,
       called_winner, called_party, status, primary_date
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code = 'NE'
ORDER BY district;
